title: Desenvolvedor .Net CORE Sênior
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Core Sênior


Descrição da Vaga


Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend .NET Core , para atuar em projetos de arquitetura moderna, utilizando microsserviços , mensageria e entrega contínua . A pessoa será responsável por desenvolver, testar e evoluir APIs escaláveis e performáticas, aplicando boas práticas de Clean Code , DDD (Domain Driven Design) e desenvolvimento orientado a objetos .

O ambiente de trabalho adota metodologias ágeis , com forte colaboração entre times multidisciplinares, e foco em qualidade, automação e melhoria contínua .


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e microsserviços utilizando .NET Core (.NET 8) ;
  • Aplicar princípios de DDD , orientação a objetos e Clean Code ;
  • Implementar soluções com mediator pattern , mensageria e comunicação assíncrona ;
  • Trabalhar com ORMs (Entity Framework, Dapper) para integração com bancos SQL e NoSQL ;
  • Criar e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração);
  • Contribuir para pipeline de entrega contínua (CI/CD) e práticas de feature toggle ;
  • Colaborar com times ágeis em um ambiente Kanban/Scrum ;
  • Participar de revisões de código e discussões de arquitetura;
  • Apoiar a evolução das práticas de engenharia e qualidade de software.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência com .NET Core (preferencialmente .NET 8 );
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e testes de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sólido em orientação a objetos e DDD ;
  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e microsserviços ;
  • Experiência com mensageria e comunicação assíncrona ;
  • Experiência com bancos SQL (e desejável NoSQL);
  • Experiência com ORMs (Entity Framework e/ou Dapper);
  • Experiência com Mediator Pattern ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e desenvolvimento com containers;
  • Experiência com entrega contínua (CI/CD) e feature toggle ;
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e colaboração com múltiplos times.


Desejável

  • Conhecimento em TDD e BDD ;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes ;
  • Experiência com Microsoft Azure ;
  • Familiaridade com Kanban ;
  • Interesse em práticas de DevOps e automação de deploy.


Venha se conectar conosco!

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.


What you will do :

  • Develop responsive and elegant web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and improve data flow.
  • Translate design mockups into reusable and scalable components.
  • Continuously optimize applications for performance and accessibility.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and a great user experience on all devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to the team’s technical growth.


What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Analista de suporte e implantação de software
description:
Estamos contratando: Suporte / Implantador de Sistema Hablla


Você é apaixonado(a) por automação, integrações e criação de fluxos inteligentes? Já trabalhou com n8n, Make ou Zapier e adora transformar complexidade em simplicidade?


Então essa vaga é para você


Na Hablla, somos pioneiros em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI), metodologia que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Performance em uma única plataforma conversacional. Nossa missão é ajudar empresas B2B a crescerem de forma integrada, inteligente e escalável.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


Implantar e configurar fluxos diretamente na plataforma Hablla, utilizando toda sua experiência prévia em automações.

Criar integrações via APIs REST e requisições HTTP, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance.

Manipular e transformar JSON em diferentes cenários de integração.

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.

Customizar cadências e jornadas de atendimento alinhadas à nossa metodologia MCI.

Colaborar com os times de Customer Success e Produto, trazendo insights para evolução contínua da plataforma.


O que esperamos de você


Experiência prática com plataformas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier ou similares).

Conhecimento sólido em requisições HTTP e consumo de APIs REST.

Domínio em JSON para manipulação de dados.

Capacidade de diagnóstico e solução de problemas em integrações.

Boa comunicação, clareza e organização no dia a dia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:


Noções de Node.js ou javascript.

Conhecimento de Webhooks e mensageria em tempo real.

Vivência em implantação de SaaS B2B, CRM ou soluções Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos


Contrato PJ

R$ 4.500,00 nos 3 primeiros meses (período de experiência)

Após experiência: R$ 6.000,00 mensais

Oportunidade de crescer em uma startup inovadora, referência em tecnologia e Marketing Conversacional.


Se você se identificou, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está transformando a forma como negócios se comunicam, envie seu perfil e venha construir o futuro da comunicação com a gente!

title: Software Engineer (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI)
description:
Role: Software Engineer – Investments (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI))

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: CST

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote (Candidates Can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Investments Technology team , helping design and build secure, scalable healthcare and identity management platforms . You’ll work across the stack using C#, .NET 8+, Azure , and Angular , while leveraging GitHub Copilot and other GenAI tools to accelerate development and innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on cloud-native, event-driven systems that power secure healthcare and financial applications in a collaborative, remote-first environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and Build Scalable Solutions: Develop secure, high-performance applications using C#, .NET 8+, Entity Framework , and SQL .
  • Architect Modern Systems: Implement REST APIs, event-driven microservices , and integrations using Azure Service Bus and API Management (APIM) .
  • Leverage Azure Cloud: Deploy and manage applications on Azure App Service , integrate messaging, and expose APIs securely.
  • Implement Secure Authentication: Enhance identity management solutions using OAuth2 and OpenID Connect for secure access control.
  • Develop Front-End Interfaces: Build responsive UIs with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML to deliver excellent user experiences.
  • Optimize Data & APIs: Write efficient SQL queries, design APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger , and use Copilot to automate documentation.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Product, DevOps, and QA to deliver seamless, high-quality releases within CI/CD pipelines .
  • Innovate with GenAI: Use GitHub Copilot and prompt engineering to generate code, API specs, and test scripts, boosting productivity and speed.


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building production-grade applications with C# and .NET Core/8+ .
  • Strong understanding of REST , event-driven , and microservice architectures.
  • Experience with Azure App Service, Service Bus, and APIM .
  • Proficiency in SQL and Entity Framework for database interactions.
  • Front-end experience with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML .
  • Expertise with OpenAPI/Swagger for API documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar GenAI tools.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in remote, cross-functional teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) or other IAM platforms.
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (HIPAA) and secure data handling.
  • Exposure to Azure Event Hubs , Kafka , or AutoGen frameworks.

title: Account Manager (Adtech)
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About Us

Orange Storm is a venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA and Barcelona, Spain. We provide an integrated ecosystem—including a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and AI-driven analytics platform—to help publishers and advertisers drive higher revenue and smarter decisions.

Our global, diverse team is our greatest asset. With a culture rooted in trust, ownership, and continuous learning, we empower talent to grow, experiment, and deliver real-world impact. We are proud of our collaborative spirit, agile execution, and commitment to building scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the ever-evolving AdTech landscape.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a high-performing Account Manager to manage and expand relationships with our advertising clients across the APAC region, including direct advertisers and agencies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end client relationships, ensuring successful campaign delivery, optimization, and KPI achievement.
  • Develop and implement advertising strategies to drive client ROI and campaign performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (operations, product, tech) to ensure smooth execution and timely issue resolution.
  • Provide clients with regular data analysis, performance reports, and actionable insights.
  • Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Stay informed about APAC advertising market trends and competitive landscape.


Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, or mobile marketing as an Account Manager or Customer Success Manager.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of advertising operations, SDKs, attribution platforms like Appsflyer or Adjust, and fraud prevention.
  • Strong project management, client servicing, and communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to optimization.
  • Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple accounts remotely across time zones.


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Attractive and competitive pay and Performance Bonus + Uncapped Revenue Commission!
  • Annual Leave: 20 working days paid leave per year (pro-rated) + local public holidays
  • Remote Work: Fully remote with reasonable overlap hours; occasional travel budget if needed
  • And many more!


Orange Storm is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity at all levels of the organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors.


We truly appreciate the time and effort every candidate puts into applying to Orange Storm. While we carefully review each application, due to the high volume of interest we receive, we’re unfortunately unable to respond to every individual submission. If your profile aligns with the role and we decide to move forward, a member of our team will reach out to you directly. We thank you in advance for your understanding and for considering a career with us.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos multicloud (Google + Azure).
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de dados (SQL + Databricks + Power BI).
  • Experiência prévia em assistentes virtuais corporativos .

  • Experiência em IBM Watson, ou Google (desejável);
  • Experiência em Mongo DB (desejável);

  • Experiência com Metodologias Tradicional e Ágil (desejável);

At Eracore , we bring innovation and precision to the forefront of electrical construction through advanced BIM modeling. description:

Modelo: 100% remoto

Fuso horário: Costa Oeste dos EUA (PST)

Contrato: contractor/PJ via Deel - Stefanini LATAM

NECESSÁRIO INGLÊS FLUENTE!


A Stefanini LATAM está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Projetos SAP AMS para atuar em nossos projetos internacionais, apoiando a Diretoria de SAP na gestão e entrega de serviços de suporte e melhorias contínuas em ambientes SAP ECC e S/4HANA .

Este(a) profissional será responsável por planejar, coordenar e monitorar as atividades de AMS (Application Management Services) , garantindo o cumprimento de prazos, escopo, custos e níveis de serviço acordados (SLAs). Atuará como ponto focal entre clientes, equipes internas e parceiros externos , assegurando qualidade nas entregas e valor agregado ao negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de suporte e projetos de melhorias SAP (AMS) , incluindo escopo, cronograma, orçamento e riscos.
  • Coordenar múltiplas iniciativas de pequenas e médias melhorias (enhancements) simultaneamente.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (SLA, backlog, tempo médio de resolução) e propor ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Facilitar reuniões operacionais e executivas com clientes e equipes AMS.
  • Apoiar análises de causa raiz e planos de correção para incidentes recorrentes.
  • Garantir conformidade com processos de change management, ITIL e SAP Solution Manager/ChaRM .
  • Supervisionar contratos AMS, validando esforços, custos e relatórios mensais.
  • Coordenar times distribuídos (Brasil, Índia, EUA) e manter comunicação fluente em inglês.


Requisitos

  • 8 a 10 anos de experiência em TI , com pelo menos 3 anos em gestão de projetos ou operações SAP AMS .
  • Experiência em múltiplos módulos SAP (ex: FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, BW, SuccessFactors, etc.).
  • Vivência com metodologias SAP Activate, ASAP ou Agile (Scrum/Kanban) .
  • Conhecimento de ITSM e ITIL v4 ; certificação ITIL é um diferencial.
  • Experiência com SAP Solution Manager, JIRA ou Azure DevOps .
  • Inglês fluente (comunicação diária com stakeholders globais).
  • Espanhol será considerado um diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso horário do Pacífico (Califórnia) .

Diferenciais

  • Certificações PMP, PRINCE2, SAP Activate ou equivalente.
  • Experiência prévia em empresas globais de consultoria ou clientes multinacionais .
  • Habilidade em liderar equipes remotas e multiculturais .

Neotalent, the responsive people.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a Senior Dynamics 365 CE Solution Architect / CRM Consultant to join one of our biggest clients, a global technology consultancy focused on delivering high-impact digital solutions across industries.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead a strategic technical assessment, contribute to the simplification and optimisation of a complex CRM ecosystem, and help define the roadmap for long-term transformation, we have the ideal project for your career.

Come energize your future with us!

• Identify sources of complexity, performance bottlenecks, and fragility

• Strong experience with integration technologies: Dataverse APIs, ESB messaging, web services

• Deep knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment strategies

• Proven experience in CRM architecture rationalisation and modernisation

• Experience assessing managed service models and support optimisation

• Advanced problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills

• Ability to translate technical findings into business recommendations

• Strong understanding of data modelling, reconciliation, and automation

• Comfortable working in fast-paced discovery phases (2–3 weeks)

• Proactive and independent, with strong alignment capabilities


Why join us:

• Work on challenging projects for big clients

• Learn more about emerging technologies

• Possibility of working remotely

• Design your career plan

• Access to continuous training and certifications

• Evolve through our internal mobility program

• … and much more!

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

O profissional participará de projetos e melhorias no módulo SAP SRH (HCM) , com foco em Benefícios (Benefits) , sendo responsável por desenvolver, customizar e manter aplicações Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP , garantindo performance, segurança e excelente experiência do usuário .


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar, adaptar ou estender aplicações SAP Fiori;
  • Atuar com codificação e arquitetura de soluções;
  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicativos SAP Fiori/UI5 voltados a processos de benefícios (adesão, consulta, alteração e cancelamento);
  • Criar e consumir serviços OData via SAP Gateway , integrando as aplicações Fiori aos dados do SRH;
  • Colaborar com consultores funcionais de RH para entendimento das regras de negócio (ex.: infotypes 0167, 0168, 0171);
  • Implementar extensões em aplicativos padrão SAP Fiori (“Meus Benefícios”, “Gerenciar Benefícios”);
  • Garantir conformidade com as diretrizes de UX/UI do SAP Fiori Design Guidelines ;
  • Realizar testes técnicos e funcionais , assegurando performance e segurança dos dados;
  • Publicar e gerenciar aplicativos no Fiori Launchpad (catálogos, grupos e roles);
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, review, retrospectiva) em conjunto com times funcionais, ABAP e de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Fiori e SAPUI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, XML, controllers, models);
  • Domínio em OData Services (criação, consumo e troubleshooting);
  • Conhecimento em ABAP OO para suporte às integrações com SRH;
  • Vivência com SAP Gateway (SEGW) e configuração de serviços;
  • Experiência com Fiori Launchpad , perfis de acesso (PFCG) e transportes SAP;
  • Domínio das ferramentas SAP Web IDE ou Business Application Studio (BAS) ;
  • Entendimento básico de Fiori Elements, Smart Controls e Theme Designer ;
  • Capacidade de análise de logs e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento dos processos funcionais de Benefícios (BEN) dentro do SRH (planos de saúde, previdência, dependentes, reembolsos);
  • Entendimento dos infotypes 0167, 0168, 0170, 0171 ;
  • Experiência em extensão de aplicativos padrão SAP ;
  • Familiaridade com DevOps, Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban );
  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP , CAP ou desenvolvimento em ambientes cloud .



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Recruiting Operations Manager
description:
Company Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a US national healthcare recruiting firm that focuses on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.


We are hiring a Recruiting Operations Manager to work directly with the CEO. This person will take ideas, conversations, and action items and turn them into completed projects. The right candidate will be the operational backbone of the recruiting process, ensuring accuracy, follow-through, and consistent momentum.


If you are organized, resourceful, and skilled at turning plans into results, this role is for you.


About the CEO and the Role

Max McNamara is the CEO of Full Spectrum Search Group. With over 13 years of search experience and a degree in Technological Entrepreneurship and Management, Max combines hands-on recruiting expertise with a strong focus on systems, process, and performance. He has also served as a coach and workflow automation consultant for one of the largest recruiting firm networks in the world, helping build smarter infrastructure and scalable operations across multiple search organizations.


Max is a visionary who thrives on ideas, relationships, and growth. He’s looking for an Integrator who can bring structure, accountability, and follow-through. This role is both strategic and tactical. You’ll be a true operational partner and someone who keeps the recruiting engine running smoothly, ensures every opportunity moves from conversation to completion, and turns ideas into measurable results.


Recruiting Operations and Workflow Management

  • Attend client, candidate, and internal meetings and own the post-meeting follow-through by ensuring every conversation leads to completed next steps
  • Manage all recruiting activity in Crelate (CRM) including job orders, candidate pipelines, and client updates.
  • Keep data clean, organized, syndicated, and current across LinkedIn RPS, Crelate, and lead spreadsheets.
  • Ensure all searches are actively moving forward and nothing sits idle.
  • Create weekly progress summaries and present during weekly team meetings


Process Improvement & Automation

  • Strong emphasis on workflow automation and continually looking for relevant and savvy ways to make things more efficient, eliminate bottle necks, etc.
  • Proactively look for areas to improve process and workflows and suggest edits
  • Become the subject matter on industry tools and technologies that can lead to better results over time.


Team Coordination and Communication

  • Collaborate with internal team members to keep projects on track and deadlines met.
  • Draft clear, professional recap messages after client and candidate calls.
  • Coordinate and manage the CEO’s calendar for efficiency and balance.
  • Follow up with recruiters and support staff to make sure deliverables are completed and priorities stay aligned.


Research, Marketing, and Deliverables

  • Research operators, facilities, and leadership teams using internal templates and data sources.
  • Maintain and update tracking lists for sourcing, outreach, and facility-level research.
  • Format and proofread MPC write-ups, job descriptions, and client submissions using company templates and tone.
  • Support marketing activities including LinkedIn posts and client-facing materials to ensure brand consistency.


What You’ll Bring

  • Excellent written and spoken English suitable for professional U.S. business communication.
  • Understanding of American business culture and communication style.
  • Experience working with US-based companies in operations and/or account/project management support.
  • Strong technology background.
  • Experience using AI to increase efficiency and automation.
  • Strong organization and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects.
  • Proficiency with CRM’s, LinkedIn, Google Sheets, and ChatGPT or similar tools.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and take ownership.
  • A professional home office setup suitable for professional video calls with executives.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and consistent availability during U.S. business hours with Central Time schedule.


Ideal Background

  • Three to five years of experience in operations or project management roles.
  • Longevity on your resume with the ability to articulate your success in similar roles.
  • Experience supporting executives or business owners in fast-paced environments.
  • Background in healthcare or executive recruiting is preferred but not required.


Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary paid in USD and based on experience.
  • Full-time remote position.
  • Central Time Schedule.
  • Performance-based growth opportunities available.

title: Senior UX/UI Engineer
description:

We’re looking for a Senior UX/UI Engineer to help build and improve internal web-based user interfaces for our Site Reliability Engineering teams. This role is ideal for a front-end engineer who loves to get hands-on with React and enjoys improving user workflows, not just coding layouts.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

O profissional participará de projetos e melhorias no módulo SAP SRH (HCM) , com foco em Benefícios (Benefits) , sendo responsável por desenvolver, customizar e manter aplicações Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP , garantindo performance, segurança e excelente experiência do usuário .


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar, adaptar ou estender aplicações SAP Fiori;
  • Atuar com codificação e arquitetura de soluções;
  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicativos SAP Fiori/UI5 voltados a processos de benefícios (adesão, consulta, alteração e cancelamento);
  • Criar e consumir serviços OData via SAP Gateway , integrando as aplicações Fiori aos dados do SRH;
  • Colaborar com consultores funcionais de RH para entendimento das regras de negócio (ex.: infotypes 0167, 0168, 0171);
  • Implementar extensões em aplicativos padrão SAP Fiori (“Meus Benefícios”, “Gerenciar Benefícios”);
  • Garantir conformidade com as diretrizes de UX/UI do SAP Fiori Design Guidelines ;
  • Realizar testes técnicos e funcionais , assegurando performance e segurança dos dados;
  • Publicar e gerenciar aplicativos no Fiori Launchpad (catálogos, grupos e roles);
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, review, retrospectiva) em conjunto com times funcionais, ABAP e de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Fiori e SAPUI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, XML, controllers, models);
  • Domínio em OData Services (criação, consumo e troubleshooting);
  • Conhecimento em ABAP OO para suporte às integrações com SRH;
  • Vivência com SAP Gateway (SEGW) e configuração de serviços;
  • Experiência com Fiori Launchpad , perfis de acesso (PFCG) e transportes SAP;
  • Domínio das ferramentas SAP Web IDE ou Business Application Studio (BAS) ;
  • Entendimento básico de Fiori Elements, Smart Controls e Theme Designer ;
  • Capacidade de análise de logs e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento dos processos funcionais de Benefícios (BEN) dentro do SRH (planos de saúde, previdência, dependentes, reembolsos);
  • Entendimento dos infotypes 0167, 0168, 0170, 0171 ;
  • Experiência em extensão de aplicativos padrão SAP ;
  • Familiaridade com DevOps, Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban );
  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP , CAP ou desenvolvimento em ambientes cloud .



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:

These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET / Vue.js)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience to join our U.S.-based client's product development team. This individual will work on the client's Docs product, a multi-tenant document management system built with modern .NET and Vue.js technologies. This is an opportunity to work on a sophisticated platform that serves customers primarily in the oil and gas industry with a proven 2-week release cadence.


This position requires an individual who enjoys having complete ownership of features from conception to production, encompassing database schema changes, backend APIs, and frontend interfaces, all with comprehensive test coverage. We believe in the "you build it, you own it, you ship it" philosophy. You'll work in an environment that values craftsmanship, modern development practices, and strategic use of AI coding assistants to amplify productivity.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across nine countries.


Core Responsibilities

  • Own Features End-to-End: Take complete ownership of features from initial design through production deployment, including database, backend ( .NET), frontend (Vue.js), testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring
  • Architect Solutions: Design and implement scalable, maintainable solutions following our established patterns (Repository-Task-Controller, multi-tenancy, service-oriented design)
  • Maintain Quality: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests using NUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions with 80%+ code coverage targets- own the quality of your code
  • Code Reviews: Review pull requests from team members and AI-generated code, ensuring adherence to architectural patterns and best practices
  • Collaborate on Planning: Work with the team in Azure DevOps to refine stories, estimate effort, and plan sprint deliverables have input in what you build
  • Mentor: Share knowledge with team members and help elevate the team's technical capabilities
  • Support Your Features: Own the operational health of features you build- troubleshoot issues, monitor performance, and participate in on-call rotation


Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core 8.0 with proper authentication, authorization, and error handling
  • Build responsive user interfaces with Vue.js 3, Vuetify 3, and modern JavaScript patterns
  • Design and implement database schemas and migrations using Dapper and FluentMigrator with SQL Server
  • Create and maintain integration connectors using our DVIC (Quartz.NET-based) scheduling framework
  • Implement message-based communication using MassTransit and RabbitMQ
  • Work with Azure cloud services (Blob Storage, App Service, Web PubSub, Azure DevOps)
  • Participate in the migration of legacy AngularJS applications to Vue.js 3
  • Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, etc.) to accelerate development while maintaining quality standards


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills; able to document technical
  • decisions and collaborate effectively
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrable full-stack expertise
  • Strong C# and .NET proficiency: Experience with ASP.NET Core, dependency injection, async/await patterns
  • Modern JavaScript/TypeScript: Solid understanding of ES6+, async programming, and modern frontend frameworks
  • Frontend Framework Experience: Production experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular (Vue.js preferred)
  • SQL Database Expertise: Strong SQL skills, experience with database design, query optimization, and writing efficient SQL queries
  • Docker: Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization, local development environments, and understanding container orchestration
  • API Design: Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs with proper authentication, versioning, and documentation
  • Testing Mindset: Track record of writing unit tests, integration tests, and maintaining high code coverage
  • Version Control: Proficient with Git workflows, pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the stack
  • Ownership Mentality: Track record of seeing features through from conception to production, including post-deployment support and iteration


Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent educational experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience with Vue.js 3 (Composition API or Options API) and Vuetify
  • Experience with micro-ORMs like Dapper or similar lightweight data access libraries
  • Familiarity with database migration tools (FluentMigrator, DbUp, or similar)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant architecture patterns and considerations
  • Experience with Azure cloud services (App Service, Blob Storage, Azure DevOps)
  • Knowledge of message bus patterns (MassTransit, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus)
  • Experience with service-oriented architecture and inter-service communication patterns
  • Background in document management, workflow systems, or enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with Auth0 or similar identity management platforms
  • Experience working with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) in a production environment


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Staff Software Engineer – .Net / AWS

Location: Fully remote (based in Brazil)

Work Flexibility: Opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for certain periods

Salary: $7,000-$9,000 per month


Role Overview

We are looking for a seasoned Staff Software Engineer who brings advanced technical acumen and an ability to take broad ownership. This is a predominantly development-focused role (approx. 90 % coding, 10 % DevOps) suited to someone who wants to be accountable for both crafting software and maintaining its operational integrity.

In this position you will help drive the evolution of a large-scale identity and access management platform, modernize legacy components, solve deep technical challenges, and provide mentorship to other engineers. If you relish complex systems and enjoy making code resilient, maintainable and efficient, this is the role for you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Investigate and resolve non-trivial system problems that traverse multiple services, systems or environments.
  • Quickly acquaint yourself with unfamiliar large codebases, often with little prior documentation.
  • Guide and coach other engineers in software architecture, debugging methodologies and technical design.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and QA functions to trace issues across deployment pipelines, APIs and operational environments.
  • Refactor and enhance existing modules to increase performance, reliability and maintainability.
  • Create and maintain documentation of key technical findings, and build diagnostic and troubleshooting frameworks that can be reused.


Required Skills & Background

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in professional software engineering, delivering production-grade systems.
  • Expert proficiency in C# and .NET (Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10+) , with an emphasis on clean, secure, scalable code.
  • Strong experience with SQL and relational database systems (e.g., MSSQL, MySQL), along with exposure to ElasticSearch and Redis .
  • Demonstrated ability to design, build and optimise distributed, high-volume data flows and integration patterns.
  • Solid familiarity with IIS , Docker , Kubernetes (EKS) , and containerization on both Windows and Linux platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (including but not limited to EKS, EC2, RDS, S3, CloudWatch).
  • Practical experience working with CI/CD and automation tools such as GitHub Actions , TeamCity , Terraform .
  • Awareness of monitoring and security tools such as Prometheus , Grafana , GuardDuty , AWS Inspector , New Relic .
  • Strong experience aross leadership, mentoring & documentation.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills and ability to thrive in a fast-moving, cross-functional engineering environment.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote working arrangement from Brazil.
  • Flexibility to work from anywhere in the world for certain periods each year.
  • Flexible working hours aligned to outcomes rather than fixed location or schedule.
  • Supportive engineering culture.

description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

title: Partner Enablement Consultant
description:
About Zensar Technologies

Zensar is a leading digital solutions and technology services company partnering with global organizations on their digital transformation journey. A technology partner of choice, with strong track-record of innovation, credible investment in digital solutions and assertion of commitment to client’s success, Zensar’s comprehensive range of services and solutions enable clients achieve new thresholds of performance. Part of the $40 billion APAX Partners’ portfolio of companies, Zensar is uniquely positioned to help existing businesses run efficiently, manage legacy transformation and plan business growth through innovative digital platform.

Working at Zensar

Working at Zensar is an enriching experience. While work is driven by innovation and passion, fun is taken seriously too. An open environment is encouraged making it easy to brainstorm with colleagues. Creative thinking is encouraged through time out activities. Moreover, the offices have been designed to foster creativity and communication, bringing a little bit of home into work every day. Zensar provides and a comprehensive benefit package for all fulltime employees.


Indigo Slate@ Zensar Company is seeking a Partner Enablement Consultant in Brazil (Remote). This is open for Full time remote with outstanding growth opportunities. All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.


Job Description

Consultants are responsible for advising, guiding, scoping, developing strategic learning plans that align to channel partner business teams and their outcomes, with a strong ability to get buy-ins from senior business stakeholders. Consultants act as SMEs for client learning programs (such as certification, products, offerings, tools, processes, training, and exams) and work with technology, L&D and business teams to drive partner workforce capacity and capability by aligning to measurable business outcomes.

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.


High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.


Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Prescribe relevant learning based on scope and workload (such as certifications, solutions, products,

etc.)

• Build custom partner learning plans, where required, based on the results of scoping/needs analysis and business priority.

• Monitor learner progress and detect any issues.

• Create and present Quarterly/Monthly Business Reviews with senior L&D/Business/Technology

stakeholders

• Monitor and analyze learning stats for data-driven decisions.

• Explore business problems and create different solution models.

• Make recommendations for improvement and present to partners and internal stakeholders.

• Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Qualifications/Requirements

We are looking for individuals with the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

• 5+ years relevant experience being an L&D consultant or in any business facing consultant role driving outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Computer Science, or a related field (required)

• Masters candidates (preferred)

• Cloud Digital Leader or Generative AI Leader (GAIL) certifications, preferred but not mandatory

• Experience in the channel partner ecosystem highly preferred


All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Zensar encourages our employees to seek higher education and training. However, this position will require you to be completely available during work hours.


Zensar believes that diversity of backgrounds, thought, experience, and expertise fosters the robust exchange of ideas that enables the highest quality collaboration and work product. Zensar is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Zensar is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. Zensar is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for persons with disabilities or religious observances, including reasonable accommodation when needed. Accommodations made to facilitate the recruiting process are not a guarantee of future or continued accommodations once hired.


Zensar does not facilitate/sponsor any work authorization for this position. All candidates must present valid authorization to commence new employment in the country for Zensar.

Candidates who are currently employed by a client or vendor of Zensar may be ineligible for consideration.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Arquiteto Devops
description:
E qual será a sua missão na Framework?

A sua missão será desenhar, evoluir e garantir a integridade técnica das arquiteturas em nuvem que sustentam nossos produtos digitais , aplicando práticas modernas de DevOps, automação, segurança e observabilidade em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .

Você será responsável por estruturar e documentar arquiteturas de referência , traduzindo requisitos técnicos e de negócio em diagramas claros e escaláveis , além de implementar pipelines, automações e padrões que garantam performance, segurança e governança dos ambientes.

Mais do que construir soluções, esperamos que você atue como referência técnica e disseminador da cultura DevOps , apoiando squads e stakeholders na tomada de decisão arquitetural e na evolução contínua dos ecossistemas em nuvem da Framework e de seus clientes.


O que é preciso para fazer parte do time?

  • Experiência sólida como Arquiteto DevOps ou Engenheiro Cloud com foco em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .
  • Domínio de CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou GitLab CI) .
  • Prática em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible, Cloud Deployment Manager ou similares) .
  • Vivência com monitoramento, observabilidade e logging (Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic).
  • Experiência em containerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, GKE).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de pipelines, políticas IAM e gestão de secrets .
  • Entendimento de arquiteturas distribuídas, escalabilidade e resiliência de sistemas .

Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com ambientes híbridos (GCP + on-premises ou multicloud) .
  • Dominar práticas de FinOps e otimização de custos em nuvem .
  • Já tiver atuado em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia com alto volume transacional .
  • Possuir conhecimento adicional em Azure ou AWS , ou ferramentas de observabilidade avançada (Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) .
  • Demonstrar pensamento sistêmico e visão estratégica , contribuindo com decisões de arquitetura e escalabilidade.
  • Certificações complementares em DevOps, SRE, Kubernetes ou Security.

title: Corporate Sponsorship Sales
description:
Vendas de Patrocínios / Estandes para nossos Congressos de Inteligência Artificial, Tecnologia e Negócios América Digital, realizados no Chile, México e Estados Unidos (

Profissionais da área comercial com mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para congressos e feiras. Podem estar baseados no México, Colômbia, Brasil, Argentina, Uruguai, Panamá ou Miami, Estados Unidos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades e funções?

  • Conduzir o processo integral de vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para nossos congressos e feiras, estabelecendo conexões diretas com C-Levels (Country Managers, Diretores de Vendas, Marketing) das 2000 principais empresas tecnológicas globais e locais.
  • Superar metas de vendas, com foco em garantir patrocínios das principais empresas de tecnologia para nossos congressos e feiras.
  • Gerenciar e cultivar relações sólidas com clientes existentes, garantindo uma experiência contínua e satisfatória.
  • Implementar estratégias para assegurar a retenção e renovação de contas-chave na carteira, transformando clientes em contas estratégicas, ampliando negócios por meio de upselling e cross-selling.
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento nas contas atribuídas, antecipando e atendendo às necessidades em constante mudança dos clientes.
  • Desenvolver planos e estratégias para ampliar a participação e maximizar o valor de cada conta.
  • Explorar ativamente novas oportunidades de negócios, identificando clientes potenciais e setores estratégicos.


Requisitos

  • Capacidade comprovada de vender e negociar em inglês.
  • Perfil hunter, com habilidades de prospecção, busca ativa de oportunidades, proatividade, autonomia, resiliência, aprendizado rápido e forte orientação para resultados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, além de sólidas competências de negociação.
  • Disponibilidade e recursos para trabalhar em tempo integral no modelo home office.
  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de intangíveis, patrocínios, sponsorships, estandes.
  • Experiência em negociação com executivos C-Levels, VPs e gerentes de marketing regionais de grandes empresas tecnológicas da região e globais.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de transformação digital, TICs, Big Data, software, IoT, e-commerce e marketing digital.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado em CRM, Microsoft Office e softwares de produtividade em vendas.


O que oferecemos? Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Salário base competitivo + as melhores comissões do mercado.
  • Cultura de trabalho colaborativa, ambiente multicultural com profissionais de diferentes países.
  • Fazer parte de uma empresa em constante crescimento.

Através dos nossos congressos no Chile, México e Estados Unidos ( somos o ponto de encontro entre fornecedores globais e locais de soluções tecnológicas em Inteligência Artificial, Cloud, Big Data, IoT, Indústria 4.0, Telecomunicações, Software, Fintech, Web3, e-commerce, Marketing Digital e CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CMOs, CDOs, CISOs, CFOs, líderes de negócios, inovação e transformação digital de operadoras, bancos, varejo, indústrias (manufatura, energia, petróleo e gás, mineração, agroindústria, utilities) e autoridades governamentais, ajudando-os a acelerar sua transformação digital e a migrar a economia dos países para uma economia digital.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*
