title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly driven Product Manager to lead the end-to-end development of Pointsville’s digital products. You’ll turn ideas into impactful solutions by connecting business goals, user needs, and technical execution. This role focuses on defining vision, setting priorities, and delivering products that drive growth, innovation, and long-term value across emerging technologies and financial ecosystems.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company goals.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new product opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Gather and analyze requirements from users, partners, and internal stakeholders to inform product design and prioritization.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, balancing priorities and timelines across multiple initiatives.


Execution and Delivery

  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create user-centric designs and intuitive experiences.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution of product features and releases.
  • Lead product launches, define success metrics, and coordinate enablement with marketing, sales, and support teams.


Performance and Improvement

  • Monitor product performance post-launch, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal teams to ensure all product features adhere to regulatory requirements in the crypto and financial services space.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment, ensuring all teams are informed, empowered, and accountable.
  • Support documentation, go-to-market readiness, and internal communication for each product phase.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in fintech or financial services, with direct crypto experience.
  • Demonstrated success of launching and scaling successful web and/or enterprise products from concept to launch.
  • Experience with varying development methodologies and leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, fintech, or emerging financial technologies preferred.
  • Skilled in data-driven decision making using metrics and analytics tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical conversations.
  • High user empathy, strong prioritization abilities, and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
description:
We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test at XILO , a fast-growing AI-driven startup transforming the insurance industry. With 200+ clients, growing data, and fresh Series A funding, we’re scaling quickly — and we’re looking for someone to help us ensure quality and reliability at every step.

You’ll take ownership of:

  • Leading CI/CD test integration and improving overall test stability and performance
  • Supporting critical release testing and mentoring engineers on writing integration/unit tests


What You’ll Bring:

  • ✔️ 5+ years of experience in software testing , with a strong focus on automation
  • ✔️ Deep knowledge of Playwright and TypeScript , and a track record of building resilient test systems
  • ✔️ Experience writing system-level and module-level E2E tests in a modern web platform
  • ✔️ Comfort working closely with developers and PMs to build test-first workflows
  • ✔️ Experience designing test strategies , introducing tools, and improving CI pipelines

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager

In this role, you will collaborate with key infrastructure stakeholders and business partners in defining project scope, interpreting requirements and priorities, and leading the modernization and transformation of systems. The projects you lead will primarily include infrastructure and application integrations and other infrastructure initiatives. Ideally you are highly skilled in communicating with technical teams, business stakeholders, and C-Suite Executives and you have a well-rounded understanding of the various components of an enterprise IT environment.


Responsabilities:

• Drive project management decisions, governance, and long-term vision.

• Analyze divisional business requirements and translate these into technical deliverables organized as Executive Milestones (In/Out of Scope).

• Analyze data to identify key insights and apply them to the business; quantitative and qualitative analysis.

• Ensure coordination of teams to drive timely completion of deliverables of large projects.

• Manage project budgets and financials, including resource allocations supporting a project’s schedule.

• Define and provide KPI’s and metrics for assigned projects.

• Interact closely with stakeholders and vendors and provide communications to executive management.

• Operationally troubleshoot or lead the troubleshooting of complex issues.

• Proactively ensure compliance (processes, standards, methodology) with expected quality.

• Responsible for project-related organizational change management including communications, training, and adoption.

• General understanding of infrastructure requirements to deploy solutions for storage, middleware, DB, voice specifics (call/contact centers), and network (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancing, WAF).

• Definition, implementation, and adoption of processes.


Requirements:

• Advanced English (mandatory)

• Bachelor’s degree and solid experience in Project/Program Management.

• Experience managing merger and acquisition infrastructure and application integration or divestiture projects preferred.

• Project Management Professional and/or Certified Scrum Master preferred.

• Experience managing requirements for multiple large, complex, and cross functional projects. Emphasis on systems, technologies, business process redesign, and knowledge of technical environments.

• Experience producing detailed project plans and resource requirements.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills – must be comfortable speaking and writing interacting with C-level audiences, as well as technical and non-technical audiences.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, and negotiation skills.

• Proven ability to write business requirements, including user stories, use case development and work-flow documentation.

• Product and project management skills; business judgment, including ability to balance resources, evaluate and address risks, and concisely articulate where trade-off decisions are to be made.

• Strong orientation to user-base, including ability to understand needs and apply this knowledge to product enhancements, online user experience, and communication content (internal and external).

title: Sr. Business Analyst & Product Design
description:
Role Overview:


The Business Analyst – Product Designer is a key member of the design team, partnering with business stakeholders and solution architects to deliver value-added features for sales, marketing, and billing teams. While the primary focus is on Service Sales CRM solutions, this role also provides exposure to a suite of enterprise applications. On a typical day you will:

Apply today to join us and build what’s next!.

title: AI Engineer | Agents
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Generativa (Generative AI Engineer) para ser uma peça-chave no desenvolvimento e evolução da nossa plataforma de Agentic AI .


Na Bren, não construímos chatbots genéricos. Nosso produto é uma plataforma avançada de múltiplos agentes (vendas, suporte, insights) que orquestra conversas de alta performance no WhatsApp. Você será responsável por projetar, construir e otimizar os "cérebros" por trás dessas interações, transformando dados brutos de conversas em vendas reais e experiências hiper-personalizadas.


Sobre a Bren

A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do WhatsApp, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. Nossa plataforma oferece funcionalidades como agendamento de reuniões, campanhas inteligentes, follow-up automatizado e muito mais, sempre com a voz da marca e com a inteligência da IA.


Responsabilidades

Sua missão será evoluir a inteligência central da nossa plataforma:


  • Desenvolver a Arquitetura Multi-Agente: Projetar, implementar e otimizar os agentes de IA (vendas, suporte, insights) e a "camada de inteligência unificada" que os orquestra.
  • Otimizar a Tomada de Decisão: Desenvolver a lógica que permite aos agentes interagir com sistemas de terceiros (ex: gateways de pagamento, calendários, CRMs) para executar tarefas complexas, como um "Frictionless Shopping Journey" dentro do WhatsApp.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação: Manter-se na vanguarda das técnicas de IA Generativa, testando e implementando novas arquiteturas de agentes, modelos e frameworks para garantir a liderança tecnológica da Bren.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com o time técnico (backend, frontend, e arquitetura) para integrar as capacidades de IA de forma escalável e segura na nossa infraestrutura (FastAPI + GCP).


Stack de IA e Ferramentas


  • Linguagem Principal: Python
  • Frameworks de IA: LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares
  • Modelos: Experiência prática com APIs de LLMs e/ou modelos open-source
  • Bancos de Dados: Experiência com Bancos Vetoriais (Vector Databases) (ex: Pinecone, Chroma, PGVector) e SQL
  • Backend & Infra: FastAPI, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)


Perfil Ideal


  • Experiência Central: Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e produção de sistemas de IA Generativa, especialmente com arquiteturas de agentes (Agentic AI) .
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Proficiência em Python e frameworks como LangChain (ou similares).
  • Domínio de RAG: Profundo conhecimento de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) , embeddings e o uso de Vector Databases .
  • Visão de Produto: Capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios complexos (como vendas conversacionais) em soluções de IA robustas e escaláveis.
  • Infraestrutura: Familiaridade com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (ou AWS/Azure), especialmente serviços relacionados a AI/ML.
  • Engenharia de Software: Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs (idealmente FastAPI ) e boas práticas de engenharia para colocar modelos em produção.
  • Diferenciais: Experiência prévia com a API da Meta (WhatsApp Cloud API) e Whatsapp Flow é um grande diferencial.


Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

  • Representar a companhia junto a terceiros (auditores, sócios, fornecedores, fisco e etc.), dominando os demonstrativos financeiros da operação.

  • Formação Superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou demais áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-Graduação ou MBA nas áreas de Finanças Corporativas, Controladoria, Administração de Negócios ou correlatos;
  • Experiência profissional comprovada em posições de liderança na área de Finanças;
  • Vivência anterior em empresas do ramo de Construção Civil Pesada ou Montagens Industriais será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos avançados dos principais softwares do Pacote Office;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região de Salvador/BA.



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura:


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Investigações;
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  • Excel Intermediário/ Avançado e BI;
  • Experiência na área de prevenção à fraude;
  • Conhecimento de coleta de dados e informações de fontes públicas (OSINT);
  • Habilitação categoria B ativa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


BENEFÍCIOS

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale refeição;
  • Auxílio material escolar (filhos);
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Wellhub;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Descontos em produtos;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Carro da empresa como ferramenta de trabalho.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (C#/.NET/React.js)
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js (preferred), Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.

You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution enhances brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations to result in lower costs, and boosts sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations utilize their technology today, processing more than $5 billion in payments annually.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform full life-cycle commercial software development and maintenance, including analyzing specifications, documenting requirements, and architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions
  • Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance
  • Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too
  • Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies
  • Analyze code to identify defect root causes and provide resolutions
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Perform high-quality peer reviews


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience, preferably React.js (Vue.js, OR Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have "ownership mindset" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks


Desired Experience (Not Required)

  • Daily use of Docker/containers (you wrote the Dockerfile)
  • Azure PaaS (Container Apps, SQL, Cosmos DB, etc.)
  • Track record of expanding scope of responsibility over time (e.g., owning more complex features, introducing new tooling)
  • Obsession with metrics, logging, and user impact


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Sales Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Sales Specialist will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: NetSuite Developer
description:
**To apply, kindly submit your resume in English. Please note that any other format will not be considered.**


Who we are:


Kajae is a premium staff augmentation company that connects top global talents to thriving US companies and clients offering fully remote opportunities. Our team hails from over 27 different countries, with the majority coming from the Philippines and Latin America. We pride ourselves on our tight-knit culture and strong bonds, despite working remotely across diverse timezones.


Benefits :


Competitive salary – paid in USD - Receive your compensation in US dollars, providing stability and global value for your hard work.

100% fully remote setup - Work from anywhere in the world—permanently. Enjoy the freedom and flexibility of a remote role while staying close to what matters most. No more commuting hassles, and more time for life’s important moments.

Healthy work-life balance - We prioritize your well-being. Through regular check-ins during your first few months, we offer ongoing support and career guidance. We also ensure you’re partnered with top-tier clients in a positive, healthy work environment.

Health insurance - Get covered starting your third month with us—your health and peace of mind matter.

Mental health support - Our in-house mental health professional is available to ensure you have access to the emotional and psychological support you need to thrive.

Referral bonuses - Know someone great? Refer them and earn up to USD 100 for every successful hire.

Fun virtual events - We host monthly virtual events filled with games, holiday celebrations, and exciting prizes. It’s a great way to connect and recharge as a team.

Kajae Spotlight bonus - Exceptional performance is recognized through our Kajae Spotlight program, where top performers earn cash rewards.

Kajae Tribe and rewards platform - Engage with the whole team through our internal social platform and earn coins for participating. Use them to bid in our lively auctions for prizes like AirPods, Apple Watches, Starbucks gift cards, shopping or experience vouchers, and more.

Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master’s or Graduate Degree—completely on us.

All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we’ve held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).


About the Role


We are seeking a talented NetSuite Software Developer who is passionate about building scalable, high-performing applications that integrate seamlessly across business systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, React, or Angular) , NodeJS backend development , and experience scripting within NetSuite . This position requires both creativity and technical depth to develop integrations, APIs, and dynamic web interfaces while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.


Responsibilities


  • Front-End Development: Build modern, responsive front-end interfaces using Vue.js (or similar frameworks such as React or Angular).
  • Back-End Development: Develop and maintain robust NodeJS services that handle data integration and automation.
  • API Integration: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful API endpoints that connect enterprise systems.
  • System Integration: Create and manage integrations between NetSuite and third-party platforms such as Business Central , QuickBooks Online , and Salesforce .
  • NetSuite Scripting: Develop and maintain SuiteScript solutions to enhance NetSuite functionality and improve workflow efficiency.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, designers, and other developers to solve complex technical challenges and ensure successful delivery.
  • Innovation: Continuously explore new technologies and methods to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability across systems.


Requirements:


  • Develop and maintain backend systems using Node.js and modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, Angular, or React).
  • Design and implement APIs, integrations, and backend logic for enterprise solutions.
  • Work with third-party APIs and enterprise systems to ensure seamless data flow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Candidates must have a strong foundation in NetSuite , either as a Functional Consultant or Technical Consultant .


Nice to Have


  • Familiarity with accounting concepts or financial software.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (NetSuite, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
  • Background in ERP systems or business process automation.
  • Experience with CRM integrations and data synchronization workflows.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


1. Backend & API Development

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs REST com FastAPI (Python).
  • Integrar serviços de backend com Snowflake e Databricks, consumindo datasets curados e expondo-os via APIs seguras.
  • Escrever SQL de forma eficiente para extração e transformação de dados (experiência apenas com ORM não atende).
  • Implementar autenticação via JWT e RBAC para garantir segurança dos endpoints.
  • Trabalhar com times de frontend e produto para definir modelos, esquemas e endpoints.
  • Garantir escalabilidade, confiabilidade e alta performance no backend.


2. Frontend Development

  • Criar interfaces responsivas e sustentáveis com React + TypeScript.
  • Consumir APIs e garantir precisão e performance na renderização dos dados no UI.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o backend para manter consistência no fluxo de dados.
  • Melhorar continuamente legibilidade, manutenção e experiência do usuário.


3. CI/CD & Cloud Deployment

  • Utilizar GitHub e GitHub Actions para CI/CD.
  • Automatizar pipelines de build, teste e deploy, mantendo padrões de qualidade e segurança.
  • Fazer deploy em Azure Cloud, garantindo consistência entre Test, UAT e Production.


4. Quality Assurance & Testing

  • Criar testes automatizados com Pytest e garantir execução no pipeline de CI.
  • Participar de peer reviews para prevenir regressões e fortalecer qualidade do código.



O que você precisa ter


  • Inglês avançado para comunicação;
  • Python;
  • FastAPI;
  • React;

Onde você vai trabalhar


No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

Atuar como responsável técnico pela unidade em que atua por meio do esclarecendo dúvidas e orientação à equipe de enfermagem e demais colaboradores, bem como pelo atendimento emergencial à clientes.

Superior completo em Enfermagem com Coren ativo e em dia;

Necessário vivência como Enfermeiro Assistencial;

Necessário experiência com gestão de pessoas;

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.


Position Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team’s products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.
  • Expand Judi, our web-based enterprise health platform, using Python, AWS services, React/Typescript, and other technologies.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.


Preferred Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.
  • Desire to work at a health tech company.
  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

What You Get:

  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;

title: SAP Data Migration Lead Consultant
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.



The ROLE

We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.


This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:


  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
  • Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
  • Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
  • Create and maintain data load programs.
  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Autonomy and Trust: Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
  • Growth Opportunities: We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
  • Collaborative Support: We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
  • Diversity of Stories: Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
  • Recognition: We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
  • Open Organization: We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Position: Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours: Must have overlap with U.S. Central Time

Start Date: Immediate

Contract Type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Duration: 3-4 months

Language Requirement: Fluent English required ( U.S.-based company)


Summary

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. You’ll combine strong manual testing skills with proven test case design and automation in .NET (C#) to raise the bar on quality across web, API, and data flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable, and observable software continuously.


What You’ll Do

  • Translate business processes into tests: Rapidly learn product/domain concepts and map endtoend workflows into highvalue test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test suites: Build and maintain comprehensive manual and automated tests (UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and exploratory).
  • Build .NET automation: Develop and maintain C# test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright , Selenium WebDriver , SpecFlow BDD , NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ) aligned to SOLID and POM principles.
  • Enable CI/CD quality gates: Integrate automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions ) with parallel runs, test reporting, and flaky-test management.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with Product Owners to refine acceptance criteria, with Developers to shift-left quality, and with business users to validate in staging/preproduction environments and in production once deployed.
  • Own defect lifecycle: Identify, document, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, screenshots, and impact.
  • Data & API validation: Test APIs, validate payloads and contracts (e.g., via Swagger/OpenAPI ), and verify database outcomes (SQL Server ).
  • Non-functional checks: Contribute to performance baselines (e.g., k6 , JMeter ), and security test coordination.
  • Test strategy & traceability: Maintain risk-based test plans, coverage maps, and traceability to requirements/ACs.
  • Mentor & improve: Share best practices, pair on tests, and improve standards for reliability, maintainability, and observability of tests.


Must Have Qualifications

  • Software quality assurance experience, including extensive manual testing and test case design.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining automated tests in .NET (C#) for UI and/or API layers.
  • Strong understanding of .NET/.NET Core , ASP.NET (MVC/Web API) fundamentals, HTTP, and JSON.
  • Hands-on with Selenium and/or Playwright , plus NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ; experience.
  • Comfortable reading application code, using Visual Studio /Visual Studio Code , debugging tests, and collaborating on testability.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control, boards/issues, and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Analista de Processamento de Dados Sênior
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Processamento de Dados Sênior



O que você irá fazer:


  • Realizar o deploy e manutenção de ambientes em Azure, AWS e GCP, garantindo performance, segurança e alta disponibilidade;
  • Atuar como Desenvolvedor BI, elaborando dashboards, relatórios e diagramas técnicos que assegurem a integridade e consistência dos dados;
  • Instalar e validar novas versões de software em ambiente de produção, conforme o cronograma estabelecido, minimizando riscos de indisponibilidade;
  • Testar e validar alterações de configuração em ambientes de homologação, garantindo qualidade antes da liberação em produção;
  • Supervisionar e validar a coleta de dados de sites de referência e medidores de painel, assegurando a acuracidade das informações;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Desenvolvimento, Suporte e Infraestrutura para identificar gargalos, automatizar processos e implementar melhorias contínuas;
  • Criar, monitorar e documentar tickets no ServiceNow, ITSM e Jira, acompanhando incidentes e solicitações de dados reportados por clientes e times internos;
  • Participar de daily meetings, revisões técnicas e cerimônias ágeis, interagindo com times globais e contribuindo para o alinhamento estratégico entre as áreas;
  • Apoiar projetos de integração entre plataformas cloud e sistemas de BI, propondo soluções técnicas que melhorem o fluxo de dados e a eficiência operacional;
  • Garantir o processamento de dados em ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção, atuando na correção de problemas dentro da plataforma Apache Airflow;
  • Realizar consultas, tuning e otimização de consultas SQL em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server);
  • Monitorar e manter infraestruturas containerizadas utilizando Kubernetes, Docker e Terraform, incluindo AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service);
  • Implementar e administrar ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade, como Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix e ElasticSearch;
  • Desenvolver e manter scripts em Python e Shell/Bash para automação de tarefas e integração entre sistemas;
  • Atuar na administração de redes e segurança, com experiência em VPN, roteamento, balanceamento e troubleshooting de conectividade;
  • Gerenciar acessos e transferências seguras de dados via SFTP e ambientes de Data Lake e Databricks;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de colaboração e documentação técnica, como SharePoint e Confluence;
  • Trabalhar com práticas DevOps, versionamento em Git e pipelines automatizados;
  • Produzir e analisar indicadores de desempenho (BI) utilizando Excel avançado e ferramentas analíticas;
  • Executar outras atividades compatíveis com a função, conforme demanda.



O que buscamos:


  • Sólido conhecimento em Linux, desenvolvimento web, tecnologias Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) e arquiteturas de dados modernas;
  • Experiência comprovada em implantação e suporte de clusters AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service), Azure Storage e outros recursos de nuvem;
  • Domínio em containers e infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform, Kubernetes e Docker;
  • Familiaridade com ElasticSearch, Kibana, Prometheus, Grafana, Databricks, Airflow, Zabbix e Apache;
  • Experiência com Python e Shell Script, com foco em automação e integração de ambientes;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de redes (VPN, switches, roteamento) e diagnóstico de falhas de conectividade;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle), incluindo consultas complexas e otimização de performance;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Grafana, ou similares) e análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento e automação DevOps (Git, pipelines CI/CD);
  • Experiência em ambientes Linux virtualizados e plataformas de virtualização;
  • Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Perfil colaborativo, comunicativo e orientado a resultados, com interesse genuíno em crescimento profissional e trabalho em equipe;
  • Inglês e espanhol intermediário, com capacidade de comunicação técnica em ambientes multiculturais e distribuídos globalmente.





O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação

  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:

  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: NetSuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – Brazil

Salary: USD 1,700/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.


MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.


Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.



Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (AWS) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .

  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.

  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.

  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.

Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential.     • Strong

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a highly organized, data-driven, and creative Marketing Operations Analyst to own the planning, execution, and optimization of multi-channel marketing initiatives of Bybit in Brazil. You will play a key role in scaling marketing operations, being responsible for growing, activating and retaining the Brazilian userbase delivering measurable results across marketing campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

  • Campaign Management: Plan, design, set up, and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns from concept to delivery.
  • Results and activation driven : creating campaigns that generate signups, first deposits and first trades in the app.
  • Process Optimization: Continuously iterate, improve, and build scalable marketing workflows and operational frameworks.
  • Channel Ownership: Manage and optimize performance across multiple channels — Email Marketing, Push Notifications, Landing Pages, Social Media, Affiliates, SEO, Paid Ads, and more.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate closely with designers, translators, copywriters, operators, and developers to ensure timely and high-quality campaign delivery.
  • Planning & Budgeting: Lead quarterly planning for regional deliverables and team budgets; ensure efficient budget control and ROI optimization.
  • Testing & Optimization: Coordinate and analyze A/B tests across strategies, cohorts, and channels to enhance conversion rates and campaign effectiveness.
  • Data & Insights: Deliver actionable insights and analyses focused on acquisition, activation, and retention strategies.
  • Localization Quality: Oversee and improve translation quality for localized content (e.g., pt-BR) across app, website, and marketing assets.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Growth, Digital Marketing, or related roles.
  • Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in marketing analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Tableau.)
  • Hands-on experience managing multi-channel marketing campaigns.
  • Excellent communication skills both in english and Brazilian Portuguese
  • Project management skills.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing, automation platforms, and performance measurement.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
  • Experience in crypto and/or fintechs is a plus
  • Bonus: Experience managing marketing efforts across multiple regions.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.
