title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

As a Senior Software Engineer you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as an influencer for our technical direction. You will be able to contribute to various initiatives as well as provide feedback through code reviews and pairing. We are especially excited about you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or if you are passionate about our mission of sustainability in creating a circular economy for high-end goods.


- Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB - Have input into design and architectural decisions that will shape the future of our software systems - Mentor, actively participate in code reviews, and pair up with a team member to work together on features - Act as a strong partner to product and engineering management


✅ Skills/Experience - Minimum Requirements:

- 7+ years of web application development experience with a track record of successfully shipping consumer or business facing products - Experience in writing reliable and maintainable code, reusable components and component libraries that may be used by many other engineers

- Experience with any of Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, NextJs, or another programming language

- Passionate about testing practices and continuous improvement

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods


Preferred Requirements: - Experience with Javascript, HTML, CSS, and React - Experience with GraphQL - Experience building microservices - Experience building eCommerce platforms - Experience working with a CMS, especially Prismic - Any experience with mobile development for iOS and/or Android


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Analista de Suporte de Redes Sociais
description:
Missão do Cargo:

Gerenciar e monitorar o comportamento dos usuários nas redes sociais, identificando tendências, interagindo de forma ativa e estratégica para prevenir situações negativas e promover melhorias na experiência do cliente. Compartilhar insights relevantes com as áreas internas, contribuindo para o aprimoramento contínuo da imagem da marca e do relacionamento com o público.

Atuamos no segmento de apostas esportivas e cassino online , o que exige atenção constante ao comportamento do mercado, comunicação assertiva e gestão cuidadosa da reputação digital, garantindo uma experiência positiva e responsável aos nossos usuários.

  • Monitorar diariamente as redes sociais da empresa, identificando menções, comentários e tendências de comportamento dos usuários.

  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos com análises de comportamento, volume de interações e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Auxiliar na implementação de ações que promovam o engajamento positivo e o fortalecimento da imagem da marca.

  • Experiência com gestão e suporte em redes sociais.

  • Excelente comunicação escrita e capacidade de resposta rápida e empática.
  • Perfil analítico para interpretar dados e gerar insights.
  • Organização e habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
  • Conhecimento básico sobre o mercado de apostas online é um diferencial.


Indicadores de Performance (KPIs):

  • Tempo médio de resposta às interações nas redes sociais.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: IT Application Portfolio Management (APM) Engineer
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


Role: IT APM Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate

Duration: 12+ Months


We are seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Application Portfolio Management (APM) Engineer to support our enterprise architecture and application rationalization efforts using LeanIX. This role is critical in capturing, analyzing, and maintaining application metadata to assess current technology usage, align future business requirements, and guide decisions on modernization, consolidation, or new application development. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote India or Brazil.


Why This Role Matters:

This role directly supports our enterprise-wide transformation by enabling smarter technology investments, reducing redundancy, and aligning IT capabilities with business strategy. You’ll play a key role in shaping our future application landscape.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

LeanIX Data Stewardship

  • Populate and maintain accurate application data within LeanIX, including ownership, lifecycle, business capabilities, and technical attributes.
  • Ensure completeness and consistency of metadata across the application portfolio.


Application Rationalization

  • Evaluate applications for business value (e.g., strategic alignment, user impact, cost efficiency).
  • Assess technical value (e.g., scalability, integration readiness, security posture, supportability).
  • Identify candidates for retirement, consolidation, or modernization.


Technology Mapping & Future Planning

  • Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to map future business requirements to existing technologies.
  • Support decision-making on whether to enhance current platforms or build new applications.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with application owners, enterprise architects, and business analysts to gather insights and validate data.
  • Facilitate workshops and reviews to ensure alignment on application strategy and lifecycle decisions.


Reporting & Insights

  • Generate dashboards and reports from LeanIX to support executive decision-making.
  • Provide insights into portfolio health, redundancy, risk, and optimization opportunities.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • 3+ years of experience in application portfolio management, enterprise architecture, or IT asset management.
  • Hands-on experience with LeanIX or similar APM tools.
  • Strong understanding of application lifecycle, business capability modeling, and technology stack analysis.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, BIZBOK) is required.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-15% travel as per business requirements.

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Colaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior | Node.js/TypeScript e AWS Serverless
description:
Na GrooveTech somos referência em inovação e excelência técnica no universo da tecnologia da informação. Atuamos com serviços de ITO (Information Technology Outsourcing), NOC 24x7 e Projetos Consultivos, sendo parceiros estratégicos de grandes empresas no Brasil.

Combinamos inteligência, tecnologia e foco em entregar soluções completas, eficientes e que geram impacto real nos negócios. Somos o seu time de tecnologia!


A pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior será fundamental na construção e manutenção da nossa arquitetura de microsserviços em nuvem. Buscamos um profissional com forte domínio em TypeScript/Node.js, que irá atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance, com foco na lógica de aplicação e na integração de serviços.


Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento Core: Desenvolver e manter APIs REST utilizando NestJS, TypeScript e Go, em uma arquitetura serverless.

Persistência de Dados: Trabalhar com o banco de dados DynamoDB para persistência e modelagem de dados.

Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Construir e manter a infraestrutura AWS serverless utilizando Terraform (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, entre outros).

Arquitetura: Desenvolver soluções seguindo padrões de Clean Architecture e princípios de alta qualidade de código.

Sistemas de Eventos: Criar e integrar serviços baseados em eventos.

Testes: Implementar testes unitários e de integração utilizando Jest.

DevOps: Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Serverless Framework, GitHub e CodePipeline.

Monitoramento: Monitorar o desempenho e a saúde das aplicações utilizando DataDog e CloudWatch.

Colaboração: Participar ativamente de revisões de código e discussões técnicas de arquitetura.


Buscamos um profissional que possua:

Experiência Sênior: Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência como Desenvolvedor Backend.

Tecnologia e Domínio: Forte domínio em TypeScript e Node.js.

AWS Serverless: Conhecimento avançado em AWS Serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, SQS/SNS, entre outros).

IaC: Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform.

Bancos NoSQL: Conhecimento em bancos de dados NoSQL, especialmente DynamoDB.

Frameworks Serverless: Vivência com Serverless Framework.

Arquitetura: Familiaridade com padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design - DDD).

Segurança/Autenticação: Conhecimento em OAuth2/JWT e sistemas de autenticação.

Testes: Experiência com testes automatizados utilizando Jest.

Containerização: Conhecimento em Docker e containerização.

Documentação: Familiaridade com Swagger/OpenAPI para documentação de APIs.

Inglês Avançado: Para comunicação com cliente internacional.


Diferenciais

Experiência com Kafka ou outras plataformas de streaming.

Conhecimento e experiência prática em Go (Golang).

Familiaridade com Dynamoose ODM para interação com DynamoDB.

Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade via DataDog.

Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

Vivência no segmento de fintech.

Conhecimento em PCI Compliance.


Informações Adicionais:

Contratação PJ

Remoto

Seguro de Vida.

Bem-Estar: Wellhub (antigo Gympass).

Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Programas de Mentoria e Desenvolvimento com nossos especialistas.

Progressão de Carreira.

title: Accounting Team Lead
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for an Accounting Team Lead to manage our accounting and payments processes while driving operational improvements across the company. You’ll oversee day-to-day financial operations, ensure accuracy in reporting, and identify ways to make our systems more efficient and scalable.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America


What You’ll Be Doing:


  • Oversee all aspects of accounting operations, including reconciliations, reporting, and data management
  • Manage payroll and contractor payments to ensure accuracy and timeliness
  • Supervise invoicing and Accounts Receivable processes, maintaining healthy cash flow
  • Lead the setup and optimization of tools like QuickBooks Online (QBO), Stripe, and Excel/Google Sheets for better financial visibility
  • Collaborate with leadership to design and implement process improvements and automation initiatives
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.



What We’re Looking For:


  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in accounting, payroll, and financial operations
  • Hands-on experience with Stripe and QuickBooks Online (QBO)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets
  • Experience with SQL, LLMs (Large Language Models), or automation tools (nice to have!)
  • Experience in fast-paced startup or SaaS environments (nice to have!)
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:


  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Hands-on experience with Stripe and QuickBooks Online (QBO)



Why You’ll Love Working Here:


Competitive Compensation

We offer a competitive monthly salary with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


Comprehensive Health Coverage:

Your health is our priority. We provide access to high-quality medical insurance, ensuring you and your loved ones have the support and care you need within your country.*


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.


Service Recognition and Rewards:

Celebrate milestones with our Elite VA program, where your commitment and achievements are honored through thoughtful rewards and heartfelt appreciation.


*Please note: For hires in Latin America, health insurance is not included. Instead, we provide alternative compensation arrangements to help support your healthcare needs.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

Location: Brazil

Mode: Remote

Duration: 1 year of contract with possibility of extension


We are looking for talents in the AdOps Data Sharing team within its Performance Marketing group. This role will be the cornerstone of AdOps Data Sharing team focusing on how to use 1st and 3rd party platforms to build impactful datasets that meet the business goals.


This role will put to use your technical skills working with data technologies with a strong ability to understand the business impact of the data. AdOps is part of the Marketing Technology Operations Team and is focused on the enablement andmaintenance of Uber’s performance marketing data. The team is highly operational, technical, and analytical, responsible for setting up accurate tracking, spend ingestion and data sharing ETLs across all paid marketing ad network channels and campaigns.


Responsibilities

• Support AdOps as a specialist in the paid marketing tech space.

• Analyze marketing event data to propose platform improvements and enhance data management.

• Build data-sharing pipelines and integrations using tools such as SQL, Python, Apache Spark, and Hive.

• Identify and optimize data sources while auditing data quality to improve campaign performance.

• Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to address dataset gaps and propose solutions.

• Validate technical implementations and ensure cross-functional alignment.

• Communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to guide requirements and data-sharing solutions.

• Work with vendor partners to ensure alignment with Uber’s goals.

• Troubleshoot issues by leveraging strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Take ownership of projects and demonstrate results in both collaborative and independent work.


Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in performance marketing tech, data analytics, technical solutions, or related roles.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, Marketing, or a similar technical discipline.

• Strong quantitative skills and proficiency with SQL, Excel, Python, Hive, Spark, etc.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems such as JIRA or Asana.

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in support or service desk roles.

• Strong communication skills, especially in explaining technical concepts to non-technical partners.

• Basic understanding of app and web tracking data for performance marketing.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Você fará parte do time que atende uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , contribuindo em iniciativas estratégicas com foco em métricas, governança de dados e apoio à tomada de decisão.

  • Boa capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e alinhamento com áreas de negócio.
  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas em um ambiente dinâmico.

title: System Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior System Engineer III to join our Enterprise Monitoring team. In this role, you will be critical to the daily operations, maintenance, and optimization of our observability platforms—Splunk, DynaTrace, and NewRelic —and will also support day-to-day ticketing and incident response workflows. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with a passion for automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities:

  • Own the daily health, performance, and availability of enterprise monitoring tools (Splunk, DynaTrace, NewRelic).
  • Perform routine maintenance, upgrades, and configuration tuning to ensure optimal system performance.
  • Triage and resolve monitoring-related incidents and service tickets in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to integrate monitoring solutions and improve visibility.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and reports to support operational and business needs.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support incident response efforts.
  • Document operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or enterprise monitoring roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk, DynaTrace, and NewRelic in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of IT operations, incident management, and ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and tool integration.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and a bias for action in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a global or distributed team.
  • Knowledge of ITIL practices and observability maturity models.
  • Certifications in Splunk, DynaTrace, or NewRelic are a plus.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).

title: Senior Data Science Analyst
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro

A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?

Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Senior Data Science Analyst para se juntar ao nosso time de Data Plataform.

O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de machine learning utilizando técnicas de classificação, regressão e clusterização;
  • Realizar testes de modelos de machine learning, incluindo, mas não se limitando a, testes A/B, testes de hipótese e validação cruzada;
  • Proficiente em feature engineering para otimizar os desempenhos dos modelos desenvolvidos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis;
  • Desenvolvimento de modelos de machine learning em cima da plataforma databricks;
  • Manutenção de modelos existentes (Acompanhamento e eventuais retreinamentos) ;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias de dados para identificar padrões e tendências relevantes;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de práticas de MLOps..

✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Machine Learning | Regressão, Classificação, Clusterização, Redes Neurais, Seleção de Features, Cross-Validation, "Curse of Dimensionality", Viés-Variânica, Explicabilidade de Modelos, etc;
  • Estatística Avançada | Análise Descritiva, probabilidade, inferência, bootstrapping, desing experimental, modelagem preditiva, otimização, testes de hipótese, regressão, modelagem e métodos;
  • Lógica de Programação | Escrever e revisar scrips e queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;
  • Data Modeling | Landing, Cleaning, Processing, Curation, Estruturas de Fato/Dimensão, encadeamento de ETLs, Data Marts;
  • Big Data | Tecnologias, Soluções e Conceitos como Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka;
  • Modelagem Estatística & Advanced Analytics | NLP, Séries Temporais, Random Forests, Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Clustering methods (e.g. K-means), Classification methods (Decision Trees/Random Forest), among others;
  • MLOps básico | para entender os desafios de se colocar um modelo em produção;
  • Experimentação | Testes A|B, Hipóteses, Modelos de Atribuição;
  • Grandes Volumes | Extrair e manipular grandes bases de dados, utilizando a stack de dados disponível.


FERRAMENTAS

  • SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;
  • Python ou R | Pra quando a coisa fica bem séria;
  • Scala, Java & Spark | Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;
  • Teste de Hipóteses | Para suportar o processo de tomada de decisão e criar informação de suporte;
  • Databricks | Uso de clusters e workspaces para BigData.


O que oferecemos

title: US Tax & Accounting Specialist – Foreign-Owned & Domestic Entities (100% Remote)
description:
About Us

At Space Financial Group, we help entrepreneurs from the US, Latin America, Brazil, and worldwide set up and run U.S. companies the right way. We specialize in LLCs, S-Corps, tax compliance, bookkeeping, and Virtual CFO services for both foreign-owned U.S. entities and traditional American clients.

We’re growing fast and need an experienced, detail-oriented accounting and tax professional who loves solving complex cross-border puzzles and delivering peace of mind to clients.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file U.S. federal (and some state) tax returns for:

- Single-member & multi-member LLCs (Form 1065, Schedule K-1)

- S-Corporations (Form 1120-S, K-1s)

- Foreign-owned U.S. disregarded entities and corporations (Form 5472, 1120)

- U.S. individual tax returns (Form 1040, 1040-NR for non-residents)

  • Manage monthly/quarterly bookkeeping and financial statement preparation using QuickBooks Online
  • Oversee payroll compliance when applicable
  • Advise clients (in Spanish, Portuguese, or English) on tax-saving strategies, entity structuring, BOI reporting (FinCEN), and compliance timelines
  • Review and correct client-provided records, flag red flags, and ensure data accuracy
  • Collaborate with U.S.-based CPAs/Enrolled Agents on complex cases while owning day-to-day execution


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent U.S. tax preparation experience with partnerships, S-Corps, and individuals
  • Practical experience with foreign-owned U.S. entities (Form 5472, 1120) is a strong plus
  • Solid background preparing Form 1040 for U.S. citizens/residents
  • Mastery of QuickBooks Online (QBO)
  • Advanced Excel skills and ability to build models or schedules
  • Fluency in Spanish , English , and Portuguese


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are…

  • Extremely organized and deadline-driven
  • Great at simplifying complex tax concepts across different languages
  • Curious about cross-border legal and tax structures
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently
  • Proactive – you spot problems before the IRS does


Compensation & Benefits

  • R$6,000 – R$9,000 BRL/month (depending on experience & certifications)
  • 100% remote – work from anywhere
  • Paid time off
  • Annual training/conference budget

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior Back-End Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software experience, including API and domain model design as well as JavaScript and Node.js development, to join our U.S. client's Platform Engineering team. The ideal candidate will design, build, and deliver high-quality, performant back-end services that power a world-class compliance and trust automation platform. The Platform Engineering team focuses on core components, such as authentication, RBAC, data architecture, and back-end infrastructure, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability across the product suite.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our clients take the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy to a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their effectiveness against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Build services and APIs in JavaScript and Node.js
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles and implement them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of back-end software development experience designing APIs and domain models with knowledge of JavaScript and Node.js
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols, such as OAuth, OIDC, and SAML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with debugging and performance testing
  • A focus on delivering value and being action-oriented
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter. Think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual, no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Profissional .NET Sênior com Inglês
description:
Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Experiência com C# e .NET/Core;

- Domínio de bancos de dados Oracle e SQL Server, incluindo criação de procedures, views e otimização de consultas;

- Vivência com Windows Forms para manutenção e evolução de aplicações legadas;

- Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful;

- Conhecimento sólido em programação orientada a objetos e aplicação de princípios SOLID;

- Prática com padrões de design (Design Patterns);

- Utilização de GIT para versionamento e controle de código-fonte;

- Conhecimento em frameworks front-end modernos, como React e Angular, desejável;

- Inglês intermediário ou avançado para leitura, escrita e conversação técnica;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Video Editor
description:
Are you a creative storyteller who knows how to turn raw footage into scroll-stopping, lead-generating, emotionally powerful video content? Do you love crafting videos that educate, inspire, and convert? If yes, we want you on our team.


Bueno Law, a purpose-driven immigration law firm, is expanding our marketing team, and we’re looking for an exceptional video editor to enhance and elevate our content across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.


Your videos will play a key role in helping people find the help they need — while driving lead traffic and brand visibility.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


You’ll be responsible for transforming raw footage into polished, high-impact videos that capture attention and keep viewers engaged.


Your work will include:


Editing dynamic video content such as:


  • Explainer & educational videos


  • Client success stories / testimonials


  • FAQ/Q&A content


  • Live consultation clips & tips


  • Motion graphics or animated support videos


  • Short-form reels for Instagram/Facebook/YouTube Shorts


  • YouTube long-form content


Core Editing Responsibilities


  • Turn raw footage into fully polished, professional content


  • Add intros, outros, subtitles, lower thirds & graphic elements


  • Add transitions, music, and sound design to elevate storytelling


  • Create engaging thumbnail concepts


  • Ensure all videos match brand identity, tone, and quality standards


  • Optimize all content for each platform (length, pacing, hooks, formatting)


  • Take feedback with a positive mindset and implement revisions quickly


  • Collaborate closely with our marketing team to bring ideas to life


WHAT YOU BRING


We’re looking for someone who is creative, dependable, and takes pride in delivering exceptional work.


Must-Have Requirements


  • English fluency


  • Proven experience editing videos for YouTube & social media


  • A strong portfolio showcasing previous work


  • Expert-level proficiency in editing apps


  • Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, and visual branding


  • Ability to meet consistent deadlines (quality + speed)


  • Highly detail-oriented and able to notice small mistakes before publishing


  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating with a team


WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US


  • Competitive compensation


  • Fully remote work environment


  • Quarterly performance bonuses


  • Paid time off + U.S. holidays


  • Your work will help us change the lives of thousands of immigrants in the U.S.


HOW TO APPLY


Please send us via email to


  • Your portfolio or links to videos you have edited (YouTube links preferred)
  • A brief note about why you’re a great fit
  • Your resume/ curriculum vitae


Email subject line: Video Editor Application – (Your Name)

O profissional fará parte de um time responsável por estruturar e consolidar a arquitetura de dados da organização, contribuindo diretamente para a criação de frameworks, processos e boas práticas que apoiam iniciativas corporativas de MDM, Data Catalog, Linhagem, Qualidade de Dados e Governança.

  • Contribuir para o desenho de frameworks e padrões técnicos de MDM, Data Catalog e Linhagem de Dados.

  • Participar de discussões estratégicas relacionadas a Data Governance e organização de papéis (Data Owner, Steward, Coordinator).

title: Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator
description:
Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator


LegalSight is an exciting legal services firm at the crossroads of global innovation. Our company provides intellectual property-related legal technology and services for clients around the world. Our team specializes in products, software, and services to assist with patent and trademark application processes, including filing, renewals, and translations.


The Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator will work within our international legal translations division. This is an administrative, non-technical position focused on document review and proofreading.


This is an entry-level, fully remote role. Working hours during the training period will be Monday – Friday 4:00PM - 12:00AM Eastern Standard Time. After the completion of the training period, regular working hours will be Monday – Friday 8:00AM - 4:00PM Eastern Standard Time.


The Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator will conduct quality assessments on translated legal documents. Key responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborate with the Project Management team to clarify project parameters.
  • Performing quality checks on translations.
  • Communicate effectively with vendors world-wide in order to reconcile errors in the translated text.
  • Implement process improvements using available technology solutions.


A successful Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator must have:

  • Experience in reviewing and proofreading translated documents, particularly legal documents.
  • Experience with CAT tools is highly preferred.
  • A high degree of proficiency in relevant computer skills (Microsoft Office).
  • Experience with Adobe Acrobat or similar tools.
  • A highly focused, detail-oriented, and client-centric mindset.
  • Ability to set and meet multiple deadlines.
  • Ability to manage time effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Proven problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work well in both independent and highly collaborative settings.
  • Ability to excel in fast-paced work environment.

title: Databricks Data Engineer
description:
Databricks Data Engineer

Fully Remote Contract


We’re looking for a hands-on Databricks Data Engineer with strong experience building scalable data pipelines using Spark, PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake. This role focuses on ingesting data from multiple sources, transforming it for analytics, and publishing high-quality datasets and visualizations.


Responsibilities:

• Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines in Databricks using PySpark, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake.

• Ingest, clean, and transform data from diverse sources (APIs, SQL databases, cloud storage, SAP/legacy systems, streaming).

• Develop reusable pipeline frameworks, data validation logic, and performance-tuned transformations.

• Design curated datasets and deliver insights through Power BI dashboards.

• Implement best practices for lakehouse development, orchestration, and version control.

• Troubleshoot pipeline performance issues and ensure data accuracy, reliability, and quality.


Required Skills:

• Strong hands-on Databricks experience (Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake).

• Advanced SQL for large-scale data processing.

• Experience integrating data from multiple structured and unstructured sources.

• Solid understanding of distributed computing, performance tuning, and debugging Spark jobs.

• Power BI (reports, models, DAX preferred).

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines in an Azure environment


Nice to Have:

• Experience with data quality frameworks, Lakehouse monitoring, or DQX

• Knowledge of Airflow, ADF, IoT, Kafka or other tools is a plus

• Experience with SAP data is a plus.

title: Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby on Rails
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O(A) Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby será responsável por:

Implementação de Soluções

  • Escrever e implementar código conforme requisitos.
  • Garantir qualidade e usabilidade do produto.
  • Testar e depurar em diferentes ambientes.
  • Contribuir em decisões de arquitetura e design.
  • Revisar código para manter padrões de qualidade.
  • Integrar componentes de software.
  • Estimar tarefas junto ao Líder Técnico e PM, utilizando métricas da equipe.


Sustentação dos Sistemas

  • Resolver chamados (erros e dúvidas).
  • Executar scripts e relatórios de apoio.
  • Garantir segurança e privacidade dos dados com apoio e revisão dos líderes e pares.
  • Participar de war rooms com TL e/ou PM.
  • Atuar pela estabilidade do sistema com SRE e TL, respondendo a alertas e prevenindo falhas.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento backend com Ruby on Rails em ambiente de produção.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de sistemas web escaláveis, considerando boas práticas de design, organização de código e manutenção de projetos de longo prazo.
  • Conhecimento sólido em modelagem de dados relacionais e otimização de queries SQL, especialmente em bancos como PostgreSQL ou MySQL.
  • Proficiência em ActiveRecord, ActionCable, ActionMailer e background jobs.
  • Experiência com performance tuning e estratégias para alta escalabilidade.
  • Práticas de testes automatizados (RSpec, Minitest, FactoryBot, etc.).


Infraestrutura e DevOps:

  • Experiência com Docker para containerização de aplicações.
  • Vivência em AWS com serviços como ECS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, ElasticSearch e Redis.
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares).


Monitoramento e Observabilidade:

  • Capacidade de configurar e interpretar métricas de APM e erros.
  • Experiência com ferramentas como New Relic, Datadog, Sentry ou similares.


Integrações e Comunicação entre Sistemas:

  • Experiência com serviços de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, Sidekiq ou similares).
  • Boas práticas em comunicação entre sistemas distribuídos (eventos assíncronos, retries, idempotência).
  • Experiência em background jobs, com foco em throughput, concorrência e resiliência.


Performance e Boas Práticas:

  • Experiência em otimização de aplicações web (tempo de resposta, uso de cache, indexação de banco).
  • Domínio em boas práticas de programação (Clean Code, SOLID, design patterns).
  • Conhecimentos de segurança de aplicações web (OWASP Top 10, autenticação, criptografia).


Desejável :

  • Experiência em integração com gateways de pagamento (ex: Stripe, Adyen, Pagar.me, Cielo, Stone, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de autenticação e segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, assinatura de mensagens).
  • Vivência com conciliação de transações financeiras e tratamento de falhas em fluxos críticos (reprocessamento seguro, antifraude, consistência de dados).


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness


Aqui é tudo sobre o "porquê" fazemos o que fazemos. Apesar de sermos o maior Grupo de academias da América Latina, sabemos que a saúde e o bem-estar devem ser integral.

title: Back End Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract: 12/01/2025 to 02/28/2026 (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


About The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Order Pricing team, responsible for building and enhancing the Pricing applications that define, manage, and apply promotions across the shopping experience. This role focuses on developing high-performance backend systems that ensure accurate, real-time pricing and promotion application to shopping bags.

Consultant will play a key role in designing scalable microservices, implementing event-driven architecture, and driving continuous delivery in a cloud-native environment.


Responsibilities:

  • Backend System Design & Development: Architect, develop, and maintain microservices in Java and Spring Boot to support pricing, promotions setup, and calculation logic.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Design and maintain asynchronous data flows using Apache Kafka for high throughput and reliability in real-time promotion processing.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment: Build and deploy services on Kubernetes, ensuring scalability, resilience, and observability across environments.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Develop and maintain automated build and deploy pipelines using GitHub Actions (GHA) and Argo CD, ensuring fast, reliable, and secure delivery.
  • Performance & Reliability: Optimize services for high performance and low latency, including caching strategies, database tuning, and message processing efficiency.
  • Monitoring & Alerting: Implement observability and operational monitoring using GCP Logging, New Relic, PagerDuty, and Grafana to ensure system health, proactive alerting, and incident response.


Requirements:

  • Experience: 6–10 years of professional experience in backend software development, preferably within e-commerce, retail, or pricing systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Java 11+ and Spring Boot.
  • Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and RESTful API design.
  • Proven experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, topics, schema registry, error handling, and message tracing).
  • Experience deploying and managing applications on Kubernetes.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (GHA) and ArgoCD
  • Knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and caching (Redis).
  • Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Azure.
  • Experience with GCP Logging, New Relic, PagerDuty, and Grafana for monitoring, alerting, and incident management.
  • Understanding of distributed tracing and log correlation best practices.

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.
